enemies.name: shardswarm
enemies.blurb: A drift of broken glass that moves against the draft, all edges.
enemies.rumor: A dry rustling, like sleet on glass, from everywhere at once.

enemies.name: glasshound
enemies.blurb: Runs like a dog and rings like a bell. The teeth are the oldest part.
enemies.rumor: Footfalls, four-beat, each one faintly ringing.

enemies.name: saltfog strangler
enemies.blurb: A patient thing of the upper galleries that hunts where lamps gutter.

enemies.name: cullet crab
enemies.blurb: Armors itself in slag and shard. Unhurried, and wrongly confident about doors.
enemies.rumor: A slow grinding, slag on stone, unhurried and confident.

enemies.name: mirrorling
enemies.blurb: Wears your outline a half-second late. It is not mocking you; it is practicing.

enemies.name: fluxworm
enemies.blurb: Swims through cooled glass as if it never set. Surfaces without warning.
enemies.rumor: The floor hums, as if something swims through it.

enemies.name: vitrified watchman
enemies.blurb: A citizen of the last day, still at their post, still enforcing something.
enemies.rumor: One voice, one note, repeating a word you almost know.

enemies.name: chorus pane
enemies.blurb: One singing sheet of a larger congregation. The harmony is load-bearing.

enemies.name: glazier's remnant
enemies.blurb: Half-melted mass of tools and maker. It still wants to finish the work.
enemies.rumor: Tools being laid out one by one, with terrible care.

enemies.name: custodian stray
enemies.blurb: A machine from a deeper epoch, off its route, executing orders nobody gave.
enemies.rumor: Machinery cycling up: something has noticed you and not yet decided.
